text:
mira: Quick announcement: starting a compatibility badge system in docs and a phased sunset for XML-style snippets used in older guides. No runtime changes.

dan: Compatibility badges? explain in one line.

mira: Each example/snippet will show a small badge: [compat: v1|v2|legacy]. This helps users pick examples that match their SDK version.

felix: XML snippets are still used in a few old onboarding pages. What's the plan?

mira: Plan: today we mark them as `legacy` and add migration notes; 30 days - docs-lint will warn on XML snippets; 60 days - new PRs must convert to fenced code blocks with a schema label; 120 days - we will auto-propose trivial conversions via PRs for unmaintained pages.

docs-bot: deploy complete (deploy-2026-03-27-11). Badges and lint rules live on staging.

san: Will there be tooling to convert XML snippets to the canonical snippet schema?

mira: Yes, a small converter and a codemod are linked on the migration page. We also provide a preview CLI so authors can validate converted snippets locally.

tara: Support note: please add a short canned reply for customers who rely on older onboarding docs.

mira: Agreed. Action items:
- docs: add badge legend and migration guide (felix + docs team)
- eng: add docs-lint rule and converter to tooling (dan)
- support: KB blurb and canned replies (tara)

dan: We'll also emit a client-side warning when the SDK loads an example marked `legacy` for 90 days so we can track usage.

mira: Thanks. Low-risk rollout, but please report any noisy lint warnings here. :sparkles:
